description: Air Traffic Movements is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore. Air passenger, cargo, aircraft and airmail movements in Changi Airport by Month. Transit passengers are passengers who arrived and departed on the same aircraft with the same flight number within 24 hours of scheduled time of arrival, to a country other than the country from which they have embarked. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
